name: API Edge Pack
summary: Hashed scoped API keys, per-tenant rate limits and quotas, and idempotency-key middleware.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: API_KEY_PREFIX
env.description: Human-readable key prefix, e.g. nb_live. Makes leaked keys identifiable in logs and greppable in code.

env.name: API_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
env.description: Fixed window length. Shorter windows reduce burst but increase write volume.

env.name: API_DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT
env.description: Requests per window when a key has no explicit limit.

env.name: API_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS
env.description: How long a stored idempotent response is replayed before the key is reusable.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Prune expired rate windows and idempotency records. Without it both tables grow without bound.
